title: Resource Factory
description: This project adds tiered blocks that serve as factories for producing raw materials like ores and gems.
body:
This mod is designed to provide a reliable way to farm resources throughout the game, from slow basic resource factories in the early game for annoying to collect resources like coal and iron, to high expensive end-game farms for items like diamonds.

This mod takes care to balance the recipes to make it so factories are still fair to get without entirely trivializing resource collection in the game.

If you are sick of constantly having to grind resources and would like to be able to automate resources once you have enough of them, then this is the mod for you!
